tests.title: Maturity Assessment
tests.tagline: How you actually think, react, and decide in real-life situations.
tests.description: 28 to 30 everyday scenarios scored across 10 areas like emotional control, decision-making, patience, and empathy. You get a score out of 100, a full report, and a personal 30-day plan as PDFs.

tests.title: Strengths Finder
tests.tagline: Find what you are naturally good at, with real examples.
tests.description: Everyday situations that show your natural strengths, like problem solving, teamwork and learning. You get your top strengths, how to talk about them in an interview, and where to use them.

tests.title: Communication Style
tests.tagline: How clearly you speak, listen and explain.
tests.description: Real conversations at work, in interviews and at home. See how you come across, where you ramble or hold back, and get simple exercises to speak with more clarity.

tests.title: Consistency Check
tests.tagline: Why you start strong and then stop, and how to keep going.
tests.description: Honest questions about routines, procrastination and restarting after a bad week. You get a consistency score, what usually breaks your streak, and a simple daily plan to stay on track.
